summary: Frontend-only READ-ONLY theme refactor verification for Ross House Rentals Expo app at https://banking-filter-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 390x844, connected to Railway PROD). Executed full flow: onboarding→Omitir→Iniciar con Email→login as yoandyross@gmail.com/admin123→verified all 5 tabs (Inicio, Propiedades, Mercado, Pagos, Perfil) in LIGHT theme→opened all 6 Perfil stack screens (Editar Perfil, Cambiar Contraseña, Métodos de Pago, Mis Servicios, Mis Contratos, Historial de Pagos)→opened property-detail from Propiedades→switched to DARK via Perfil>Apariencia>Oscuro→re-verified Inicio, Propiedades, Pagos, Perfil, Editar Perfil in dark theme. Zero React runtime errors, zero pageerrors, zero 'Cannot access C before initialization' / 'createStyles is not defined' / red screen crashes. Text is legible on every screen visited in both themes (dark text on light surfaces in light mode; light text on dark surfaces in dark mode). No mutating actions were performed on the production backend.

issues: The Mexican flag pill/badge in the top-right of the Mi Perfil header renders as a nearly-invisible light-gray circle in dark mode (low contrast against the dark card gradient). Minor cosmetic — not blocking. See dark Perfil screenshot.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. These are benign RN-Web deprecation warnings surfaced only in the web preview; they are not from the theme refactor. Consider a codebase-wide sweep to migrate shadow*/pointerEvents-prop usages to their StyleSheet equivalents.

Console warning: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?'. Something in the codebase passes transform-origin as a raw DOM prop on web — likely inside an <svg> or a style object using the kebab-case key. Non-blocking but should be migrated to camelCase transformOrigin.

A single non-critical 404 was observed on '/(tabs)' load ('Failed to load resource: 404'). Likely a missing image/icon; did not affect rendering. Worth checking with Network tab which asset is 404-ing.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) In Perfil header (dark mode), give the country/flag pill a visible border or background so it doesn't blend with the dark card gradient.
(Optional) Migrate remaining shadow* style props and props.pointerEvents to their non-deprecated equivalents to silence RN-Web warnings.
(Optional) Fix the raw 'transform-origin' → 'transformOrigin' style key somewhere in the codebase (grep for 'transform-origin').
(Optional) Track down the one 404 asset request on the tabs layout.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme refactor appears clean: no scoping bugs surfaced (no 'Cannot access C before initialization', no 'createStyles is not defined', no undefined-C errors) across ~13 distinct screens visited in both light and dark modes.

Theme switch persists and applies live (dark selection immediately restyles the current Perfil screen and every subsequently-visited screen) — indicates ThemeContext + useColors() hook wiring is correct.
No text-on-same-color legibility issues detected in either mode on any screen tested.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (13/13 screens rendered without errors in both themes tested)

seed_data_creation: None — strictly read-only session, no forms submitted, no data mutated on Railway prod.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App public URL: https://banking-filter-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend is PRODUCTION Railway (read-only). Login flow: Onboarding shows first — tap 'Omitir', then 'Iniciar con Email', fill email+password inputs, tap 'Iniciar Sesión'. Theme is persisted in localStorage key 'rh-theme-mode' — Playwright starts in light by default. To go dark, tap Perfil tab → scroll to 'Apariencia' section → tap 'Oscuro' card. Stack screens covered from Perfil menu: Editar Perfil, Cambiar Contraseña, Métodos de Pago, Mis Servicios (Xcel Energy demo), Mis Contratos, Historial de Pagos. Property detail reachable from Propiedades tab by tapping any card. Screens NOT covered this iteration: Mercado detail, admin-* screens, chat/messages, faq, forgot-password, add-* screens, maintenance/legal/emergency stacks — main agent can spot-check if desired but the ones I visited are already representative of the refactor pattern (useColors + createStyles).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a verification pass, not a bug-fix. The global light/dark theme refactor is verified working end-to-end across all screens listed in the review request.
